notes.title: Action Mode Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We've heard all your feedback and are committed to giving our fans the best experience we can, so we're excited to announce that we've been working on a free upcoming game mode along with various improvements to existing mechanics.

This mode will be focused on a more active action-oriented experience.  Standing atop a tower in the clouds, hold off a goblin balloon assault as long as you can while keeping yourself and your tower safe from arrows and bombs.  Be prepared to break a sweat!

notes.title: Leaderboards Update - 4/11
notes.content:
Leaderboards are now in, try and set some new records or beat the dev challenge high score!

Changes:
- Added global leaderboards for each mode, shows top 5 + local player
- Changed controls/instructions in the lobby to be more visual
- Changed bow to unnock arrow if the bow is released
- Tweaked challenge mode to despawn targets and pots when time runs out instead of after
- Changed position of exit button
- Adjusted button materials

notes.title: Minor Update - 4/8
notes.content:
Changes: 
- Added simple bow and arrow control option, toggle with touchpad button
-- No quiver, just draw bow string and an arrow will automatically be nocked
- Fixed non-flying arrows being able to hit menu buttons and juggle apples

notes.title: Minor Update - 4/7
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added automatic left hand mode for bow and arrow, lefties rejoice!
- Adjusted apple juggling physics to be more floaty and less punishing
- Added delay between apples in juggling mode
- Changed spectator camera to be off by default, press menu button to turn it on
- Increased haptic strength for object grabbing and bow draw
- Clarified controls description
